name: How long does it take to remove a shower?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove a shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a shower removal depends on several factors, including the type and size of the shower, the complexity of the plumbing, and the materials involved. A simple shower stall removal might take a day or less, while a more complex custom shower or a tub-to-shower conversion could extend to several days, especially if unforeseen issues arise or if the area needs extensive repairs afterwards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Shower removal time varies, typically from one day for simple stalls to several days for complex units or conversions.
